title: An imported historical invoice is not sent to QuickBooks Online
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin (all permissions) at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919) on the What/Why QuickBooks host (for example qb1.qa.shopview.com).
  • The shop has an active QuickBooks Online connection to sandbox company {Sandbox-company-A} (for example ShopView QA Sandbox), and you can sign in to that sandbox.
  • Import file {File-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-WW-A10.csv) is made from the Invoices import template with one Labor row: invoice number {Invoice-number-A} (for example ZZWW-A10-1), customer {Customer-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-WW-A10 Fleet), *Line Title (for example Replace tie rod) and Line Description (for example excessive play).
custom_steps:
1. Open Settings and, under Data Import, click Invoices.
  2. Upload {File-A} and start the import.
  3. Read the import result message.
  4. Wait 5 minutes. Do not import the file again.
  5. Sign in to QuickBooks Online and open sandbox company {Sandbox-company-A}.
  6. Search the sandbox invoices for {Customer-A} and for {Invoice-number-A}.
  7. In ShopView, open the QuickBooks Unexported Items list.
  8. Look for {Invoice-number-A} or {Customer-A}.
  9. In ShopView, open the imported invoice {Invoice-number-A}.
  10. Read the line's title and description.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 3: the file imports with no error.
  • Step 6: the sandbox has no invoice for {Customer-A} or {Invoice-number-A}: the imported invoice was not sent.
  • Step 8: nothing for {Invoice-number-A} or {Customer-A} is in Unexported Items (it was not tried and failed either).
  • Step 10: the title and description read as written in {File-A} (for example Replace tie rod and excessive play).

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-11257; story SV-10132 (Story 3, What Reaches QuickBooks); PRD "What Are You Doing / Why Are You Doing It (What/Why)", Confluence 845348896, version of 13 Oct 2026, S3-R12, read 13 Oct 2026; no design board exists for this story (tech plan: Story 2 and Story 4 are text-only), labels from the Jira story and tech plan; tech plan "Title and Description - Technical Implementation Plan" (dated 2026-09-23, shared by the QA lead 13 Oct 2026), FR-014; Source-verified 13 October 2026; not yet build-verified (a What/Why QA build exists; verification by the build verification session).

  • S3-R12: “An imported historical invoice never reaches the live QuickBooks sync, so its line text is unaffected whatever the import wrote into it.”
  • Tech plan FR-014: “No backfill/resend; parts, shop supplies, fee/discount rows unchanged; credit memos untouched; imported historical invoices unaffected; reversals after release carry new text (S3-N1, S3-N3, S3-R12, S3-E2, §2 Out of scope).”
